# A representative build platform does not limit language-pack CPU support

The localized Debian repack kind declares that language packs support all CPU architectures and selects only linux64-shippable/opt as a representative input platform. It depends on shippable-l10n and requests the deb-l10n format. Keep this task selection separate from claims about the Architecture of a generated package. Final package metadata depends on transform and packaging code beyond this comm configuration; no package was built or inspected.

Scope: Localized Debian task platform selection.
